summary_1line: Ravana recruits Maricha to lure Rama away with a golden deer so he can abduct Sita, despite Maricha’s warning about Rama’s power.

image_candidates.scene_text: The golden-horned deer glitters in the forest while Sita watches in wonder outside the hermitage.
Ravana, disguised as a shaven-headed ascetic with a staff and water pot, waits near Rama’s forest hut.
Maricha, struck by Rama’s arrow, cries out in Rama’s voice across the forest as he falls.
